reader_summary.overview: This is Dom Cooke and today we are breaking down the freight railroad business, Union Pacific. Union Pacific is interesting for a number of reasons. Its first tracks were laid in a time of horsepower, over 150 years ago.

key_points.text: It operates a duopoly in the West of the US with Burlington Northern Santa Fe, a rail owned by Berkshire Hathaway.
And despite being capital intensive, it earns higher operating margins than Microsoft.
But above all, it is a crucial link in the global supply chain, moving much of what the US economy is built on.
